maya (People Ops): Quick heads-up: small runbook for last-minute peer asks + extension path. Keeping this short. :loud_sound:

maya (People Ops): Deadlines to remember: peer feedback by 2026-03-31, manager reviews by 2026-04-10 23:59 PDT, calibration 2026-04-13 to 04-17. If you're juggling PTO or travel, act now.

rowan (Eng Manager): My team has two folks traveling this week. Can I request staggered deadlines for only those two?

maya (People Ops): Short answer: yes for peers. Managers can request up to 48h for individuals due to travel/PTO by using the extension form: https://intranet.redwood/hr/extension-request. In the form note which employees and the reason. We approve case-by-case.

anya (IC): If I miss the peer feedback deadline because Im on customer travel, will my manager still get my feedback in time?

maya (People Ops): If it's close, ask your manager to leave a short note in the review form summarizing your contributions and flag that peer feedback will arrive late. We prefer peers to submit directly, but managers can add temporary context.

kelly (People Ops): Also, if you see the review form clear the "calibration notes" field after saving, screenshot and DM us immediately. Were rolling a patch tonight.

hr-bot: Reminder set: "Peer feedback due in 7 days" will DM contributors on 2026-03-24 09:00 PDT.

rowan (Eng Manager): Thanks for the clarity  will submit the short extension form now.

maya (People Ops): Thanks  and please cc your director for awareness. If anything looks off in Lattice (missing reports), ping this thread. :white_check_mark:
